en: Black‑and‑white image showing a formal military ceremony at the entrance of a barracks or palace courtyard. Uniformed guards with plumed shakos and ornate cartridge pouches stand at attention, some holding trumpets. A striped guardhouse and iron gate are visible on the right, with steps leading up to a covered entrance. In the background are long, low barracks‑style buildings decorated with wreaths or garlands, and a tall flagpole flying a long, horizontal flag.
